\label{proposition-duality-compactly-supported}
In Situation \ref{situation-shriek} let $f : X \to Y$ be a morphism of
$\textit{FTS}_S$. Then the functors $Rf_!$ and $f^!$ are adjoint in
the following sense: for all $K \in D^b_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_X)$
and $L \in D^+_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_Y)$ we have
$$
\Hom_X(K, f^!L) =
\Hom_{\text{Pro-}D^+_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_Y)}(Rf_!K, L)
$$
bifunctorially in $K$ and $L$.

final_content.statement:
Fix a Noetherian base scheme $S$; let $\mathrm{FTS}_S$ be the category of separated schemes of finite type over $S$. For $f:X\to Y$ in this category, the *upper shriek* $f^!$ sends $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^+(\mathcal O_Y)$ to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^+(\mathcal O_X)$ and is built from proper compactification $X\hookrightarrow\bar X\xrightarrow{\bar f}Y$ by $j^*a_{\bar f}$, where $a_{\bar f}$ is right adjoint to $R\bar f_*$. The corresponding *lower shriek* $Rf_!:D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Pro}(D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_Y))$ is $R\bar f_*Rj_!$ for any compactification; proper pushforward is applied termwise to the pro-system. Then for every $K\in D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_X)$ and every *bounded-below coherent* $L\in D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^+(\mathcal O_Y)$ there is a bifunctorial isomorphism of Hom sets
\[
\operatorname{Hom}_{D(X)}(K,f^!L)
\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Pro}(D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^+(\mathcal O_Y))}(Rf_!K,L).
\]
The right side regards $L$ as a **constant** pro-object; this is the coherent pro-category analogue of an adjunction, not an ordinary adjunction between $D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(X)$ and $D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^+(Y)$ alone.
hypotheses: f in FTS_S, K bounded coherent on X, L bounded below coherent on Y, compactification-based upper/lower shriek.

semantic_review_note: Pinned duality.tex L8503 in FTS_S over Noetherian S asserts a BIFUNCTORIAL pro-category adjunction Hom_X(K,f^!L)≅Hom_Pro(D_Coh^+(Y))(Rf_!K,L) for K bounded COHERENT and L bounded-BELOW COHERENT. The final retains the pro-object lower-shriek Rf_! built by compactification and pro-extension, treats L as constant, and does not mistake this for ordinary Hom adjunction on two ordinary categories.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-compactly-supported-triangle}
In Situation \ref{situation-shriek} let $f : X \to Y$ be a morphism of
$\textit{FTS}_S$. Let
$$
K \to L \to M \to K[1]
$$
be a distinguished triangle of $D^b_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_X)$.
Then there exists an inverse system of distinguished triangles
$$
K_n \to L_n \to M_n \to K_n[1]
$$
in $D^b_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_Y)$ such that the pro-systems
$(K_n)$, $(L_n)$, and $(M_n)$ give $Rf_!K$, $Rf_!L$, and $Rf_!M$.
